column1: # Jagex entries GadScape's DataMigration imported from rev 225 (OpenRS2 1943), generated by gadconv config.Rev225Gen
# from the rev-225 evidence cache (not a build input). Columns: kind (config group or 'model'), id,
# import|edit and the CRC-32 of the USER bytes it was classified with (hex). An import row covers a run of up to 32 consecutive
# ids from the given one, one CRC per id (comma-separated); an edit row holds one id and rev 225's bytes (hex, 211 layout).
# import: BASE's newer entry replaces the USER copy (treated as vanilla). edit: the user's edit is re-applied onto
# BASE's entry with rev 225's as the merge base. An id whose CRC no longer matches USER is ignored.
